header: The six latest reviews, newest first
lead: Every review here comes from a customer with an active licence. We publish them unedited and in date order, which is why a three-star review is second.
note: Softwarelotse collects the reviews once a year and passes them on unchanged. We can't delete or reorder them, and the average is recalculated nightly.

reviews.quote_text: Four years, two warehouse moves and one takeover later, it's the only software here nobody has asked to replace.
reviews.author: Katrin Weissgruber

image.alternative: Portrait of a man in his thirties.

reviews.quote_text: We bought it after the demo, then spent six weeks finding out our own article data was the problem. Support told us on day two. The missing stars are our fault.
reviews.author: Stefan Aigner

image.alternative: Portrait of a woman in her twenties.

reviews.quote_text: It does what it says. The reports are the weak part: I still copy the year-end figures into a spreadsheet to get our accountant's layout.
reviews.author: Ines Kofler

image.alternative: Portrait of a man in his fifties.

reviews.quote_text: There are two of us and one shop, and we never felt too small to be a customer. The price has gone up twice, and both times they wrote to explain why.
reviews.author: Lena Brandtner

reviews.quote_text: Reliable and unexciting, which I mean as praise. The mobile view of the reorder list needs work.
reviews.author: Doris Ebner

image.alternative: Portrait of a man in his thirties.

reviews.quote_text: The handhelds took some getting used to, and setting up the barcodes took an afternoon. Since then, counting stock is no longer a big event.
reviews.author: Tobias Reisinger
